# Pixelette Certified

> UK-headquartered cyber security, compliance, assurance and AI governance consultancy supporting organisations internationally.

Pixelette Certified helps organisations meet cyber security, compliance and AI governance requirements. It assesses what is required, addresses gaps, implements appropriate controls and prepares organisations for independent certification, attestation or assessment.

Pixelette Certified is a consultancy. It is not a certification body and does not issue certificates. SOC 2 examinations and reports are performed by licensed CPA firms. Cyber Essentials certification is awarded by Certification Bodies licensed under the scheme. Independent certification, attestation and scheme decisions are made by the relevant authorised third party.

It works through a specialist delivery network, matching appropriately qualified practitioners to each engagement while remaining the client's principal point of accountability. Practitioner credentials are held by the individuals to whom they were issued, not by Pixelette Certified.

Office: 77 Fulham Palace Road, London W6 8JA. Contact: info@pixelettecertified.com.

## Core services

- [ISO 27001 readiness & implementation](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-27001): Information security management system readiness for independent certification.
- [AI governance & ISO 42001](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-42001): AI governance frameworks, risk and impact assessment, NIST AI RMF alignment and ISO 42001 readiness.
- [SOC 2 readiness](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/soc-2): Controls, evidence and operating discipline to prepare for a SOC 2 examination by a licensed CPA firm.
- [Cyber assurance & testing](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/cyber-assurance): Vulnerability assessment, application, API, network and cloud testing, penetration testing and remediation validation.
- [Privacy & data governance](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/privacy): Privacy information management, including ISO 27701, with national privacy laws scoped to the applicable jurisdiction.
- [vCISO & GRC advisory](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/vciso): Flexible senior security leadership and ongoing governance, risk and compliance support.
- [Business continuity & operational resilience](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-22301): Business impact analysis, continuity and recovery planning, and ISO 22301 readiness.
- [GCC cyber & regulatory compliance](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/gcc-regulatory-compliance): Support with NCA, SAMA, NIA, NISCF, QCB and GCC privacy requirements.
- [Cyber Essentials readiness & certification support](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/cyber-essentials): Readiness, remediation and submission support for the UK scheme.

## Evidence policy

Pixelette Certified does not publish pricing, client case studies, testimonials, certification counts, pass rates or delivery times. Client case studies are published only where the client is named, has given written permission and every statement can be substantiated.
